notes_as_reported: Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a cabin air (nominally 0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1.0 atm ambient environment.  The droplet deploys and ignites with little residual velocity and stays within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test.  The droplet burns with a very luminous flame that obscures droplet in HiBMS for a large portion of the test.  The droplet burns to disruption at a small droplet size with the last part of the droplet history obscured by the luminous flame.
